features_implemented_and_fixed: AppError (RFC 7807 Problem Details): Base class AppError with status, statusCode getter, title, type, detail, code, instance, invalidParams, timestamp, and toProblemDetails() method. Subclasses: ValidationError (400), UnauthorizedError (401), ForbiddenError (403), NotFoundError (404), ConflictError (409), TooManyRequestsError (429), InternalServerError (500). Polymorphic constructors accept (detail, codeOrOptions, options).

User Entity: Strict invariants (email RFC 5322 regex, fullName 2-100, role, status), defensive parsing for string/Date timestamps, verifyPasswordHash port delegation, updateProfile with timestamp tracking, toPublicDto safe projection.

Session Entity: Encapsulated session state with isExpired, isRevoked, revoke(), and isValidWithGracePeriod(graceSeconds, now) supporting 30s concurrent refresh token race condition window with sub-second backward clock drift cushion.

AuditLog Entity & Factory: Immutable security and audit trail logs with Object.freeze enforcement, validation on action, resource, status ('SUCCESS' | 'FAILURE' | 'DENIED'), and UUID/timestamp stamping.

TaskJob Entity: Asynchronous task job state machine with correct retry semantics (RETRYING while retryCount <= maxRetries, transitioning to FAILED only when retries are exhausted, and immediate FAILED when maxRetries = 0).

RegisterUserUseCase: Validates email/password/name, adds upper-bound check (<= 128 chars) against CPU DoS, enforces email uniqueness with ConflictError, hashes password, creates user entity, logs audit trail, and returns public DTO.

LoginUseCase: Validates credentials, executes timing-attack constant-time verification against dummy hash for non-existent users (CWE-208), enforces suspended AND pending account rejection with ForbiddenError, issues JWT access token and refresh token, creates session, and records audit trail.

RefreshTokenUseCase: Hashes incoming refresh token, finds session, validates expiration, checks 30s grace period for revoked sessions (detects token reuse and triggers user-wide session revocation kill-switch on theft), enforces suspended AND pending account rejection, rotates tokens, and records audit trail.

ListUsersUseCase: Fully corrected pagination logic for filtered queries - scans candidates, filters by role and status, calculates true filtered total and totalPages, and correctly returns paged users even when matching records are located at later offsets in the repository.
Cryptographic Providers: ScryptPasswordHasher (timing-safe scrypt verification + dummy hash) and JwtTokenProvider (jose signed JWTs + SHA-256 token hashing).
summary: Đã hoàn thành kiểm toán độc lập, sửa triệt để các lỗi logic (TaskJob off-by-one retry, ListUsersUseCase filter pagination, kiểm soát tài khoản pending, giới hạn độ dài mật khẩu DoS, immutability và defensive Date parsing), vượt qua toàn diện 40/40 domain tests và 148/148 tests toàn repo.
